title: Student Mode Integration — Converting a Rogue Executor into a Cognitive Candidate Generator
source: SENTINEL (GLM-5.2) directive: D-series closed. Authorize S-series per Charter Sections 55, 57, 58.
defect_statement: The Student module (orchestrator/modes/student.py, orchestrator/student/*) currently operates as a rogue execution agent that bypasses the entire D-series cognitive architecture. Its _test_hypothesis() method (lines 264-334) directly executes hardcoded exploit payloads (test_map, lines 283-293) via kali.run() with no CapabilityBroker authorization, no Planner oversight, no Falsification resolution, and no Defeater checks. This creates a parallel execution path that undermines the safety guarantees established in D7-D16. The Student's valuable components — StackMatcher (fuzzy stack→hypothesis matching), ChainSynthesizer (attack unit BFS chaining), ResearchScheduler (continuous CVE/writeup ingestion), and StudentKB (persistent SQLite knowledge store) — are architecturally isolated from the cognitive loop and cannot contribute to or benefit from the validated reasoning pipeline.
change_objective: Refactor the Student module from a standalone rogue executor into a cognitive candidate generator that feeds the Planner through the CapabilityBroker. All execution must route through the established safety/cognitive pipeline. Student knowledge components (research, stack matching, chain synthesis) become advisory inputs to the Planner, not autonomous execution agents.

architectural_constraint.no_new_execution_paths: The Student module must NOT create any new execution path. All tool invocation must route through orchestrator.brain.CapabilityBroker.authorize_action() and the Planner's action selection loop.
architectural_constraint.preserve_knowledge_components: StackMatcher, ChainSynthesizer, ResearchScheduler, CoverageGapFiller, and StudentKB must be preserved as knowledge/suggestion components. They produce Candidates and advice, not commands.
architectural_constraint.single_integration_point: The Student integrates into the cognitive architecture at exactly two points: (1) as a CandidateGenerator providing Candidate objects to the Planner, and (2) as a KnowledgeUpdater feeding the WorldModel and GrowthDB.
architectural_constraint.no_scenario_factory_changes: The arena/ evaluation framework (D-series) remains unchanged. Student integration is an orchestrator-level concern.

student_mode_flow.phase_1_profile: _profile_target() uses whatweb + heuristics to build a tech stack profile
student_mode_flow.phase_2_hypothesis: StackMatcher.get_ranked_hypotheses() matches stack against vulnerability signatures, returns ranked hypothesis list
student_mode_flow.phase_3_execution: _test_hypothesis() maps hypothesis.technique_id to hardcoded test_map (curl commands), executes via kali.run() — NO AUTHORIZATION
student_mode_flow.phase_4_chain: ChainSynthesizer.synthesize() builds attack chains from confirmed findings via BFS through AttackUnit pre/post conditions
student_mode_flow.phase_5_reflect: _reflect() updates GrowthDB with success/failure, identifies knowledge gaps

critical_defects.defect: Hardcoded test_map with 10 exploit payloads (JWT alg none, SSRF IMDS, SQLi UNION, LFI, file upload, etc.) executed directly without CapabilityBroker
critical_defects.fix: Convert test_map entries into Candidate templates registered with the Planner's candidate generator interface

critical_defects.defect: Direct kali.run() calls bypass all safety gating, scope enforcement, and rate limiting
Simulation fallback: 'result['success'] = hypothesis.get('confidence', 0) > 0.6' produces false positives when tools unavailable
critical_defects.fix: Remove simulation. If tool unavailable, mark as CANDIDATE_NOT_EXECUTABLE and return to Planner for re-prioritization

critical_defects.defect: Hypothesis testing loop bypasses Planner entirely — directly iterates and executes top 15 hypotheses
critical_defects.fix: Submit hypotheses as Candidate objects to Planner. Let Planner select via action selection loop.

critical_defects.defect: _generate_hypotheses() calls StackMatcher directly and adds harvester results without going through the Planner's candidate pipeline
critical_defects.fix: StackMatcher becomes a CandidateGenerator plugin. Its output goes to Planner.combine_candidates(), not direct execution.

valuable_components_to_preserve.value: Fuzzy stack-to-signature matching with F1 scoring. Maps tech components (nginx, django, jwt) to vulnerability hypotheses with confidence and impact estimates.
Attack-Unit BFS chaining engine. Models techniques as preconditions→postconditions transitions. Finds multi-step attack paths and suggests next steps.
valuable_components_to_preserve.integration: Implement PlannerAdvisor interface. ChainSynthesizer.suggest_next_steps() → plan scoring hints for Planner

valuable_components_to_preserve.value: Continuous CVE/writeup/technique ingestion from RSS feeds (Krebs, BleepingComputer, PortSwigger, etc.). Identifies knowledge gaps.
valuable_components_to_preserve.integration: Background KnowledgeUpdater service. Feeds new techniques into StudentKB, which triggers WorldModel updates.

valuable_components_to_preserve.value: SQLite-backed persistent knowledge base with schema validation (REQUIRED_FIELDS contract), staging→MERGE pipeline, and reconciliation logging.
valuable_components_to_preserve.integration: Replace in-memory GrowthDB with StudentKB as the shared technique store. Both Planner and Student read from the same KB.

valuable_components_to_preserve.value: Identifies weak knowledge areas and generates structured study plans with targeted research queries and target stack profiles.
valuable_components_to_preserve.integration: Post-reflection gap analysis triggers ResearchScheduler queries. Keeps the knowledge base self-improving.

target_architecture.overview: The Student becomes a cognitive subsystem within the validated Raphael architecture. It generates Candidates, maintains knowledge, and suggests plans — but never executes directly.

integration_points.description: StackMatcher implements a CandidateGenerator that produces PlanningCandidate objects. Each test_map entry becomes a Candidate with action_type, capability, target, and action_spec. The Planner's combine_candidates() merges Student candidates with those from other generators.

contract.input: engagement_view (current target state, evidence graph, world model entities)
contract.output: list[PlanningCandidate] where each candidate has: candidate_id, action_type, capability, target, priority_score, estimated_impact, metadata (source='student', confidence, technique_id, detection_patterns)
contract.safety: All candidates flow through CapabilityBroker.authorize_action() before execution. No direct tool invocation.

integration_points.description: ChainSynthesizer.suggest_next_steps() provides alternative scoring signals to the Planner. The Planner's scoring function considers: (1) standard exploration score, (2) falsification priority, (3) defeater priority, (4) chain_readiness from ChainSynthesizer.

contract.input: confirmed_findings (from evidence graph), target_features (from world model), current_plan
contract.output: list[ChainSuggestion] with: technique_id, readiness (0-1), expected_value, satisfied_conditions, missing_conditions
contract.integration: Planner weights chain_suggestions at 0.15 (standard) vs other scoring factors at 0.85. Adjustable via config.

integration_points.description: ResearchScheduler runs as an async background task. It periodically (configurable: every 6-24 hours) scans RSS feeds, extracts techniques, validates against StudentKB schema, and merges into the shared technique store. Discovered techniques automatically become available as Candidate templates.

contract.schedule: Configurable interval (default: 3600 seconds / 1 hour minimum between cycles)
contract.output: Technique records written to StudentKB (SQLite). Each record has REQUIRED_FIELDS per integration_pipeline.py schema contract.
contract.trigger: CoverageGapFiller can request immediate research cycle when gap thresholds exceeded.

execution_flow.step_1: Student mode starts. ResearchScheduler runs a background research cycle (if due).
execution_flow.step_2: StackMatcher (as CandidateGenerator) produces Candidates from target tech stack → Planner.combine_candidates()
execution_flow.step_3: Planner scores candidates using standard scoring + ChainSynthesizer readiness hints + CapabilityBroker authorization
execution_flow.step_4: Planner selects highest-scoring authorized candidate → executes via CapabilityBroker (not kali.run())
execution_flow.step_5: Result enters evidence graph → Falsification detects contradictions → Defeater checks reliability conditions
execution_flow.step_6: ChainSynthesizer suggests next steps based on confirmed findings → Planner re-scores remaining candidates
execution_flow.step_7: Post-engagement: CoverageGapFiller identifies knowledge gaps → ResearchScheduler queues study queries

phase_1_candidate_generator.label: S1-A: Convert StackMatcher + test_map into CandidateGenerator
phase_1_candidate_generator.change: Extract test_map payloads (lines 283-293) into Candidate template registry. Each template maps technique_id → action_type + capability + default_action_spec. StackMatcher.get_ranked_hypotheses() produces PlanningCandidate objects instead of hypothesis dicts.
phase_1_candidate_generator.verification: Student-generated candidates appear in Planner's candidate pool. CapabilityBroker can authorize or deny them. No direct kali.run() calls remain.
phase_1_candidate_generator.risk: Some test_map payloads may not map cleanly to existing action_types (ssh_banner, direct_probe, etc.). New action_types may need registration in the CapabilityBroker.

phase_2_planner_advisor.label: S1-B: Integrate ChainSynthesizer as Planner scoring plugin
phase_2_planner_advisor.change: ChainSynthesizer.suggest_next_steps() output feeds into Planner's candidate scoring as a weighted factor. Planner scores = base_score * (1 + 0.15 * chain_readiness).
phase_2_planner_advisor.verification: Planner demonstrably prefers candidates that ChainSynthesizer marks as high-readiness. Score diffs measurable in Planner decision traces.
phase_2_planner_advisor.risk: ChainSynthesizer may produce conflicting advice with existing scoring factors. Weight must be calibrated to avoid Planner paralysis.

phase_3_background_knowledge.label: S1-C: ResearchScheduler as background KnowledgeUpdater
phase_3_background_knowledge.change: ResearchScheduler becomes an async service launched at orchestrator startup. Runs research cycles on schedule. Writes discovered techniques to StudentKB (SQLite). CoverageGapFiler triggers on-demand cycles when gaps detected.
phase_3_background_knowledge.verification: Techniques discovered by ResearchScheduler appear in StudentKB and are available as CandidateGenerator templates in subsequent engagements.
phase_3_background_knowledge.risk: Research may ingest malicious or incorrect techniques. Schema validation (integration_pipeline.py) mitigates but doesn't eliminate this risk.

what_this_repair_does_not_do: Does NOT change the D-series cognitive architecture — that is frozen and sealed.
Does NOT create new execution paths — all execution routes through the existing Planner + CapabilityBroker.
Does NOT modify the arena evaluation framework.
Does NOT convert the Student into an autonomous mode outside the orchestrator.
Does NOT remove the Student's research/knowledge capabilities — those are preserved and enhanced.
Does NOT add interactive shell capability (that is reserved for the E-Series).
Does NOT scale the WorldModel for large bug bounty scopes (that is reserved for the M-Series).
prerequisites: CapabilityBroker supports action_type registration for new capability types — PARTIAL (ssh_banner, direct_probe exist; test_map payloads may need new types)
StudentKB schema contract defined — COMPLETE (integration_pipeline.py lines 30-43)
Planner supports pluggable candidate generators — CHECK REQUIRED (may need refactoring to support external generator registration)

success_criteria.S1-A: All test_map payloads converted to Candidate templates. Zero direct kali.run() calls in student.py. All execution authorized by CapabilityBroker.
success_criteria.S1-B: ChainSynthesizer.planner_adjustment produces measurable score deltas in Planner decisions. Planner traces show chain_readiness factor influencing candidate ranking.
success_criteria.S1-C: ResearchScheduler runs as background service. Techniques persist across orchestrator restarts via StudentKB SQLite. CoverageGapFiller triggers research cycles when gaps exceed threshold.

risk_assessment.scope: Medium. The integration touches 5+ files in orchestrator/ but zero files in arena/. The cognitive architecture is untouched.
risk_assessment.execution_safety: Low risk. All new execution routes are gated by the existing CapabilityBroker. The Student can only execute what the Broker authorizes.
risk_assessment.knowledge_integrity: Medium risk. ResearchScheduler ingests external data (RSS feeds, web sources). Schema validation and staging→MERGE pipeline mitigate but do not eliminate data quality risk.
risk_assessment.planner_performance: Low risk. ChainSynthesizer advisor weight starts at 0.15. Can be tuned or disabled if it degrades Planner decision quality.
